title: Spicy Tunisian Flatbread
description: A flavorful flatbread inspired by Tunisian cuisine, perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the Tunisian Flatbread into 1-inch thick slices.
Brush both sides of the flatbread slices with olive oil.
Grill the flatbread slices for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
Meanwhile, mix the Spicy Kick Sauce and Rye Bread Crumbs in a small bowl.
Once the flatbread is cooked, brush the Spicy Kick Sauce mixture onto the flatbread slices.
